name: ellmos-controlcenter-mcp
description: MCP control plane for local MCP server, tool and skill discovery, profile resolution and config generation, capability bundles, skill catalogs, and policy audits, plus a policy-gated, audited gateway that lists and invokes tools on backend MCP servers the host has not loaded.
author: Lukas Geiger
features: Gateway: list and invoke tools on servers the host has not loaded
